errors.text: The hypothesis reverses the key kinetic interpretation: it predicts surface-reaction-limited behavior after formation of the high-temperature barrier, whereas the target reports parabolic, diffusion-controlled oxidation with biphasic growth at the optimum condition.
It assigns the optimum primarily to 950 °C rather than the target SPS condition of 1000 °C.
The proposed secondary phases are speculative Mg-Al-Ti intermetallics or Mg-Fe-Co oxides rather than the identified barrier oxides AlV2O4, FeAl2O4, and FeTiO3.
The predicted density, hardness, corrosion current, and oxidation-test conditions disagree substantially with the reported results.
